intermediateFailures.detail: Inactive hidden screens were incorrectly counted as role leaks, frozen public Orbitron font failures were mixed into dashboard health, and protected-file parity did not normalize BOM/line endings.

All 3 browser tests passed, but the validator rejected the disposable branch name redo/r08-correction-regression. It passed unchanged after renaming the branch to redo/r09-regression, which matches the approved descendant rule.
Round 3 accessibility evidence stores measured pass fields in nested objects rather than a top-level pass/checks list. The adapter was corrected to recursively require every recorded pass field.

warnings: Two request failures to the existing frozen public Orbitron asset at fonts.gstatic.com were isolated and recorded; no dashboard remote font request occurred.
